subject: CrewHealth SOC2 evidence: least-privilege & SSO artifact intake
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.m@crewhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Adler <tom.adler@crewhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CrewHealth SOC2 evidence intake — least-privilege & SSO samples

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for agreeing to work with our SOC2 auditor on the access control pack. Auditor requested a small set of artifacts focused on least-privilege and SSO/SCIM proofs. Can you share the following items (sampled where noted):

- Role ownership matrix (CSV or XLS) showing role -> owner and last attestation date (sample: all admin roles + 5 application roles)
- SAML assertion samples for interactive browser SSO (3 recent successful assertions, redacted PII ok)
- SCIM delta snapshot covering a 24h period showing creates/updates/deletes (sample of 100 events)
- List of service accounts and justification for those with non-human privileges (top 20 by token usage)

Our timeline is tight — auditor wants intake by next Friday (2026-09-03). Let me know if that’s feasible and whether we should accept artifacts via your secure Drive folder or if you prefer a different transfer method.

Also include any short README that explains sampling approach and redaction rules.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Elena
Head of Security, CrewHealth

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.m@crewhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CrewHealth SOC2 evidence intake — least-privilege & SSO samples

Elena — thanks for the clear list. I’ve looped in Irene from Security Ops and Soojin from Customer Success; Irene will assemble the artifacts and Soojin will coordinate delivery logistics.

Initial answers/timeline:
- Role ownership matrix: we can export and provide a filtered XLS with owner and attestation dates by EOD 2026-09-01.
- SAML assertion samples: we can pull 3 assertion logs with headers and timestamps; we will redact PII before handing off. ETA: 2026-09-01.
- SCIM delta snapshot: we can provide a 24h sample (JSONL) and a README describing sampling method. ETA: 2026-09-01.
- Service accounts list + justification: we will provide the top 20 by token usage with short justification notes; ETA: 2026-09-03.

Preferred transfer: secure Drive folder (please confirm the link you provided works for you). If you need a signed NDA or different transfer mechanism, flag now.

Irene — can you pick this up and confirm you can meet the dates above?

Thanks — Jordan
Director, Customer Security Liaisons
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Elena Morris <elena.m@crewhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CrewHealth SOC2 evidence intake — least-privilege & SSO samples

On Sun, Aug 28, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the clear list. I’ve looped in Irene from Security Ops and Soojin from Customer Success; Irene will assemble the artifacts and Soojin will coordinate delivery logistics.
>
> Initial answers/timeline:
> - Role ownership matrix: we can export and provide a filtered XLS with owner and attestation dates by EOD 2026-09-01.
> - SAML assertion samples: we can pull 3 assertion logs with headers and timestamps; we will redact PII before handing off. ETA: 2026-09-01.
> - SCIM delta snapshot: we can provide a 24h sample (JSONL) and a README describing sampling method. ETA: 2026-09-01.
> - Service accounts list + justification: we will provide the top 20 by token usage with short justification notes; ETA: 2026-09-03.

Hi all — attaching the initial bundle into the Drive link you shared. Quick notes on the artifacts included:

Attachments (in Drive):
- role_ownership_matrix_v1.xlsx — columns: role_id, role_name, owner_email, last_attested (ISO date), scope (global/project)
- saml_assertion_samples.csv — columns: timestamp, issuer, audience, in_response_to, nameid_format, attributes_summary (redacted)
- scim_delta_sample.jsonl — newline-delimited JSON events (create/update/delete) sampled 2026-08-19 00:00-23:59 UTC; sampling method: deterministic window + top-affected users sampling

Sampling & redaction notes (README.txt in folder):
- We redacted nameid values for non-essential PII; assertion metadata (issuer, audience, timestamps) retained for auditor review.
- SCIM snapshot includes event_id, timestamp, change_type, resource_type, actor_id (hashed), and a short change_summary. Full raw logs are available under a separate request if required by your auditor.
- Service accounts: exported top 20 by token activity (last 90 days). Column "justification_short" contains the high-level reason (integration, infra automation, analytics). For accounts with elevated privileges we included the last rotation date and whether keys are in KMS.

If the auditor needs more granular logs (e.g., raw SAML responses or full SCIM audit trail), we’ll need a formal request (to track the scope) — happy to produce that following your confirmation.

-J
Irene Choi
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: role_ownership_matrix_v1.xlsx (XLSX), saml_assertion_samples.csv (CSV), scim_delta_sample.jsonl (JSONL)

From: Elena Morris <elena.m@crewhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Adler <tom.adler@crewhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CrewHealth SOC2 evidence intake — least-privilege & SSO samples

Irene / Jordan — received, thanks for the fast turnaround and the README. A couple quick follow-ups from the auditor:

1) Can you include a short extract showing service account rotation events for accounts that had privileges elevated in the last 12 months (rotation date + rotation method: KMS/manual/third-party)?
2) Auditor asked for a one-paragraph statement confirming that role attestation is performed (who signs off, cadence) — a short statement is fine.

If you can add those two items by Friday 2026-09-03, we should be good for intake. If delivery slips, flag immediately.

Thanks — Elena
Head of Security, CrewHealth
